title: First do no shameful work; then blush
english: Best: do nothing shameful. Next best: [[be ashamed >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:63]] after shameful deeds — do not walk brazen as if still just. The devil blocks repentance by shamelessness.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Each examine what deserves blush
english: [[Let each examine himself >> Bible:1 Corinthians 11:28]]: word, deed, thought that deserve blush before him who [[searches heart and kidneys >> Bible:Psalm 7:9]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
